title: Nemo ɗigogi a cikin mazurarin ku kuma bincika sashin tattalin arziki
course_title: Tallace-tallacen Ci gaba: Matsala, Gwaje-gwaje da Ci gaba mai Dorewa

say: Nemo ɗigogi a cikin mazurarin ku, kuma bincika sashin tattalin arziki.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module na ɗaya na Tallan Ci Gaba.
Wani kamfen yana tambaya: mutane nawa tallata ta kai?

say: Tallace-tallacen girma yana yin tambaya mai faɗi. A cikin duk wanda ya ji labarinmu, nawa ne suka yi farin ciki, suna biyan kuɗi, masu dawowa abokan ciniki waɗanda suka kawo abokai? Yana ɗaukar tafiya a matsayin tsari ɗaya, yana gano mafi rauni, kuma yana gyara shi da ƙananan gwaje-gwaje masu aunawa.

say: Ci gaban da ke asarar kuɗi akan kowane abokin ciniki ba girma bane. Misali, Chioma tana sayar da maganin fata da man shanu daga Ibadan. A watan da ya gabata ta kashe Naira 150,000 a tallace-tallacen Instagram kuma ta sami sabbin kwastomomi 50.

card.title: Shin yakamata Chioma ya daidaita tallace-tallace na Instagram?

say: Kudin sayan abokin ciniki, ko CAC, sabbin abokan ciniki ne ke kashewa daga wannan tashar: Naira 3,000 kowanne.

card.title: Shin yakamata Chioma ya daidaita tallace-tallace na Instagram?
rows: CAC: farashin kowane sabon abokin ciniki

say: Matsakaicin odar ta na Naira dubu 10 ne da rata kashi 40 cikin 100, don haka kowane oda yana samun babbar riba naira 4,000. Abokan ciniki suna saye kusan sau 3 a shekara, don haka ƙimar rayuwa, ko LTV, ya kai naira 12,000.
Wannan shine 4 zuwa 1, kuma odarta ta farko ta riga ta biya CAC. Za ta iya yin awo a hankali, tana kallon CAC kowane mako.

card.title: Shin yakamata Chioma ya daidaita tallace-tallace na Instagram?
rows: CAC: farashin kowane sabon abokin ciniki

say: Yi amfani da babbar riba, ba kudaden shiga ba, don LTV. Yi lissafin CAC don kowane tashoshi daban. Yi amfani da lokacin da za ku iya kiyayewa kawai. Kuma lokacin da kuka haɓaka, haɓaka kashe kuɗi a matakai, misali 20 zuwa 30% a kowane mako.

say: Yin amfani da kudaden shiga na iya sa tashar hasara ta zama lafiya. Hada tashoshi yana ɓoye mara kyau a bayan mai kyau. Kuma CAC sau da yawa yana hawa lokacin da kuka ninka kasafin kuɗi, don haka sake ƙididdige kowane lokaci.

say: Yawancin kwastomomin Najeriya suna biyan kowace megabyte, sun fi son canja wuri ko kuma a biya su a kai, kuma masu sayar da jabu sun kona su. Don haka lever na farko shine amana: bidiyon abokin ciniki, girman gwaji, tabbataccen shafin biyan kuɗi, da amsa cikin sauri.

panel.heading: Levers da ke aiki a Najeriya

cards.d: Nuna hujja da wuri, ba da matakin farko mai ƙarancin haɗari, yi amfani da ingantacciyar hanyar biya, ba da amsa da sauri.
Shafukan haske, hotuna masu matsawa, kasidar WhatsApp, gajerun bayanan murya.
K = gayyata ga kowane abokin ciniki x rabon wanda ya saya. Kyauta kawai bayan abokin ya biya.

say: Lever na biyu shine mutunta farashin bayanai. Kowane shafi mai nauyi ko dogayen bidiyo yana kashe kuɗin abokin cinikin ku kafin ta sayi wani abu.

say: Biyan tukwici ne kawai bayan biyan kuɗin sabon abokin ciniki, da lada ga kowane mutum, don haka babu wanda ya ƙirƙira asusun karya ko kuma tura kanta da lamba ta biyu.

panel.heading: Kare abokan ciniki da kasafin ku
items: Biyan lada kawai bayan share biyan kuɗi
Kyautar hula ga kowane mutum
Kar a taɓa tambayar OTPs, PIN ko bayanan katin
Faɗa wa jama'a cewa ba za ku taɓa yi ba

say: Kada ku taɓa tambayar abokan ciniki bayanan OTPs, PINs ko bayanan katin akan WhatsApp, kuma ku faɗa musu a bainar jama'a cewa ba za ku taɓa yin hakan ba, saboda masu zamba suna kwafi shahararrun tayin da aka bayar.

say: Don tunawa. Auna duk matakai biyar. Gyara zubewar tare da bayyananniyar dalili da gyara mai arha. Bincika LTV zuwa CAC kuma ku biya kowane tashoshi. Kuma duba riƙe kafin ku zuba kuɗi a cikin tallace-tallace, ko ku cika guga tare da rami a ciki.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: AARRR: matakai biyar, kowanne da lamba
Zaɓi ɗigon ruwa tare da gyara mai tsabta, mai arha
CAC = tashar ciyarwa / sababbin abokan ciniki
LTV = oda x margin x umarni
Bincika riƙewa kafin ƙaddamar da tallace-tallace

say: Yanzu taswirar mazurari na gaske tare da ƙimar matakinsa, gina takaddar tattalin arziƙin naúrar don tashoshi biyu, da ƙirƙira madaidaicin madaidaicin gida tare da dokokin hana zamba.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Taswirar mazurari na gaske
Gina takardar lissafin tattalin arziki
Zana madauki na gida
